annotations.title: AI log triage (root cause from app logs)

description: AI log triage (root cause from app logs) — Paste application or server logs (text=, or POST JSON {text} for long logs, or url= of a plain-text log file; up to the last 5,000 lines) and get an incident triage: offline pattern mining groups lines into templates (numbers, IPs, UUIDs, hex ids, URLs and quoted strings masked) with counts, level and first/last line; fatal/error/warn counts, error ratio, error bursts by minute, exception types, the first error, and a verdict HEALTHY / WARNINGS ONLY / DEGRADED / FAILING / CRITICAL. Then Workers AI names the likely root cause (earliest causal error, not the symptoms), confidence, impact, severity SEV1-SEV4 and next steps, citing pattern ids. ai=false returns only the offline report. JSON. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).
